newsitem.title: UK: EBRD makes two senior management changes.
newsitem.headline: EBRD makes two senior management changes.

text.p: LONDON, June 26 (Reuter) The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) announced two senior management changes at the bank.
Noreen Doyle, deputy vice president of finance, has been appointed as risk manager at the bank and has also been appointed to the EBRD's executive committee, it said.
At the same time, the EBRD said Kazuya Murakami will replace Junichi Maruyama as director of the bank's Kazakstan/Uzbekistan team. Maruyama is returning to the Japanese Ministry of Finance.
